column1: Unique application identifier of the prospective mortgage customer. The column name is shortened to just ID.
column2: Indicates whether the prospective mortgage customer applied online.
column3: The city name entered on the mortgage customer’s applicantion.
column4: Amount of outstanding credit card debt across all credit cards held.
column5: The number assigned to a credit card, which is used to uniquely identify the individual card holder and the card issuer. A credit card is a payment card issued to cardholders by a card issuer to enable the cardholder to pay for goods and services.
column7: A date value in format month/year representing a credit card expiration date. Expiration dates usually consist of a month and year only. In such cases, the cards remain valid until the last calendar day of that month. If, for example, an expiration date reads 06/19, this means it can be used until midnight on June 30, 2019.
column9: A 3 or 4 digits number representing a credit card validation number. The validation number for Visa, Master Card and Discover is a 3-digit number printed on the back of the card. It appears after and to the right of the card number. The American Express validation number is a 4-digit number printed on the front of the card. It appears after and to the right of the card number.
column11: The education level entered on the mortgage customer’s application.
column12: The marital status entered on the mortgage customer’s application.
column14: The employment status entered on the mortgage customer’s application.
column15: The gender entered on the mortgage customer’s application.
column16: The annual income of the mortgage customer.
column17: Total amount of all outstanding loans.
column18: The marital status entered on the mortgage customer’s application.
column19: Identifies if a mortgage applicant is a default risk. Valid values are YES and NO.
column20: The full name of the mortgage customer applicant.
column21: The number of credit card accounts.
column23: The phone number entered on the mortgage customer’s applicantion.
column25: The residence selected by the mortgage applicant - Valid values = Owner Occupied, Public Housing, Private Housing, Renting, Sheltered, Living with parents/guardian etc.
column26: The sales price of the mortgage property.
column27: The social security number entered on the mortgage customer’s application.
column29: The full state name entered on the mortgage customer’s applicantion.
column30: The state code representing the state entered on the mortgage customer’s application.
column31: The street address of the mortgage customer applicant.
column32: Indicates the length of residence at current address.
column33: Indicates the number of years of employment with current employer.
column34: The zip code entered on the mortgage customer’s application.
